museums.taste: Contemplative art in nature and in strong architecture: land art, sculpture parks, light and space, zen, Tadao Ando, Isamu Noguchi, Dani Karavan, James Turrell. Liked: Murou Art Forest, D.T. Suzuki Museum (Kanazawa).

_rules: Only add items that are actionable or new. Never add 'no news' items such as an artist having no tour dates.
Only research the focus place while focus.until has not passed; then remove its items.

Bucket list: every morning check each bucketlist wish for a genuinely good moment (price drop, season, availability, rare deal). Add at most one feed item per wish with kind 'bucket' and 'bucket': <wish id>, only when it is actionable, and notify when one appears.

bucketlist.title: See the northern lights
bucketlist.good_time: a strong aurora season with dark, clear skies, and flights or trains north that are unusually cheap about two months ahead
bucketlist.where: Northern Norway, Swedish Lapland, Finnish Lapland, Iceland

bucketlist.title: Sleep in a beautiful mountain forest hut
bucketlist.good_time: an unusually cheap or newly bookable hut in a quiet mountain forest, ideally reachable by train
bucketlist.where: Europe within reach of the Netherlands, or wherever he is travelling

bucketlist.title: Own a 1€ house in Italy
bucketlist.good_time: a mountain or forest village opens (or reopens) a €1-house call with a clear deadline, or publishes houses still unassigned, with a modest deposit (about €5,000 or less) and at least two years to renovate
bucketlist.where: Piccole Dolomiti (Recoaro Terme, Valli del Pasubio, Posina), Farini (Val Nure), Ollolai (Sardinia), Pignone (Liguria), Montieri (Tuscany)

bucketlist.title: Own an affordable house in the mountains in a beautiful l forest
bucketlist.good_time: a house in a forested mountain area listed very cheaply (roughly under €15k / ¥2.5M) through an official vacant-house bank or clear listing, or a region opening a relocation or renovation grant, ideally while he can visit in person
bucketlist.where: Northern Okayama (Nishiawakura, Niimi, Maniwa), rural Japan akiya banks, Italian Alps and Apennines

wingfoil: test days and demo events near Den Haag (Scheveningen, Brouwersdam, lakes): gear tests, clinics, brand demo days
